transcript.text: "Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"I'm from Columbus, Ohio."
Nods slowly. "Columbus, Ohio. I'll remember that. Everybody's from somewhere that isn't here."
"What do you miss about before?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Miami, Florida had this smell after rain — concrete and wet leaves. I'd forgotten it until just now, saying it out loud."
"About that question — we never finished."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Yeah?"
"Hm. Never mind — go on."
"About What do you miss about before? — we never finished."
"What I miss most? The feeling that tomorrow would look like today. The small stuff. It's always the small stuff."
"What do you think?"
"My take? We're not going to like the answer, whatever it is."
"Paint me the picture."
"I've got things to see to. Don't be a stranger."
"Tell me more."
"I don't miss pretending I was busy. Turns out I was just... occupied. There's a difference."
"...Actually, forget it."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

"Yes."
"Knew it. You've got good instincts for this stuff."
